youtube_title: Burning Chest After Dinner? It's How You Sleep | Body Fix #5 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #5. Dinner, straight to bed... then a BURNING chest? Acidity?
B is right. Sleep on your LEFT side with your head end raised. Less acid comes up.
The real mistake: lying down right after eating. Keep a 2-3 HOUR gap.
Fix: Smaller dinner, less spicy and oily at night, a short walk before bed.
Red flags: Trouble swallowing, vomiting, weight loss, or every week? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Heartburn and acid reflux
